integrity: The universal statement is proved by resultant reduction, finite congruence counting, and Möbius inversion. The bundled computations test two examples only and are explicitly corroborative rather than a proof of the general theorem.
limitations: Specific to fixed homogeneous binary forms with nonzero homogeneous resultant. No coefficient-uniform error term, nonhomogeneous extension, or optimal error is claimed.
title: Finite-resultant correction for coprime values of homogeneous binary forms
